senses.gloss: m. (preced.) teacher, esp. Tanna, an authority quoted in Mishnah and Boraitha, contrad. to אֲמוֹרָא.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ות׳ תונא</he> and the Tanna (of the Mishnah) is a confirmation (confirms what I say).—<he>ת׳ קמא</he>, v. <cite ref="S01439"><he>קַמָּא</he></cite>.—<he>ת׳ ברא</he>, v. <cite ref="B01153"><he>בַּר</he></cite> I ch.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 93b:9">B. Bath. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ת׳ בתרא וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="B01157"><he>ברא</he></cite>) every later (Ar. outside) authority comes only to enlarge the sphere of the subject.

<cite ref="Sotah 22a:3">Sot. 22ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>תני ת׳ ולא ידע וכ׳</he> a teacher teaches and knows not what he says (repeats verbatim what he has heard without understanding the subject).—Pl. <he>תַּנָּאִים</he> (h. form, fr. <cite ref="V00720"><he>תַּנַּאי</he></cite>), <he>תַּנָּאֵי</he> (fr. <cite ref="V00717"><he>תַּנָּאָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sotah 22a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הת׳ מבלי עולם</he> the Tannaim (repeaters) ruin the world, expl. <he>שמורין הלכה מתוך משנתן</he> who give decisions based on traditions they have learned (without knowing their reasons and their application to practical cases).—
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:12">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>תרי ת׳ אליבא דר״מ</he> these contradictory opinions are the relations of two Tannaim in behalf of R. M.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 33a:7">Snh. 33ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>שיקול הדעת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00950"><he>דַּעַת</he></cite>) <he>כגון תרי ת׳ וכ׳</he> when two Tannaim or two Amoraim differ in their opinions, and it has never been decided which is to be adopted in practice.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63a:10">Ib. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כת׳</he> it depends on Tannaim, i.e. Tannaim differ on that point.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9a:28">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>והני ת׳ כהני ת׳</he> and those teachers differ on the same principle as these do.

<cite ref="Berakhot 49a:15">Ib. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ואת שבקת כל הני ת׳ ואמוראי וכ׳</he> and you ignore all these Tannaim and Amoraim, and act according to Rab’s opinion?; a. v. fr.—V. <cite ref="V00720"><he>תַּנַּאי</he></cite>.
